verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a SaaS compliance platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The llms.txt index, agent-readable markdown docs, OpenAPI schema and Postman collection are developer building blocks for agents, not an MCP server. Its in-product agentic workflows are a different feature and do not count either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
